card.name: The word clinical before status terms
card.fires_on: The word "clinical" (also "presenting", "a", "General") right after "the", "with", or "had", where a patient-assessment noun such as status, situation, symptoms, course or evidence comes next.

modes.label: Clinical before assessment noun
modes.description: "clinical" after a determiner or preposition, ahead of status, situation, course, symptoms or evidence.
modes.example: Consider ketone monitoring in patients at risk for ketoacidosis if indicated by the<< clinical>> situation.

modes.label: Other qualifier words
modes.description: Words like "presenting", "a" or "General" that introduce a clinical noun or department name.
